integratedOutcomeSeam.ownership: Integration combines M0 chain facts, M2 eligibility, and frozen execution identity; M1 only consumes the result
integratedOutcomeSeam.eligibilitySource: Integration-owned; M1 never derives final eligibility
integratedOutcomeSeam.runtimeValidation: required strings and raw evidence artifact refs are non-blank; identity/evidence hashes are lowercase SHA-256; required booleans are explicit booleans; strictChainExact=true requires completeChainSuccess=true

negativeBoundary.note: BoundarySwitch is intentionally weaker than PairExact and ignores malformed unbound negative intent.

repeatAggregation.rule: a pair-level metric passes only when every matched repeat passes

summaryCampaign.frozenPairSetShaSemantics: external canonical content hash from the frozen data artifact; M1 validates shape and records it but does not pretend pair IDs reconstruct data content
summaryCampaign.expectedPairIdsShaSemantics: M1-computed membership hash over split and sorted expectedPairIds; invariant across Variant and execution cohort

frozenPairSlotManifest.source: validated PairContractV2 records plus Integration-owned frozen raw-evidence references
frozenPairSlotManifest.globalUniqueness: pairId, raw evidence artifact ref, raw evidence artifact SHA-256, and runId may not be reused across slots
frozenPairSlotManifest.summaryTraversal: ordered trusted slots are the oracle; untrusted score.pairId is only a declaration checked against its assigned slot

summaryCampaign.mixedCohortPolicy: campaign incomplete; mismatched scores excluded from metric denominator
summaryCampaign.missingPairPolicy: campaign incomplete; jFrozen remains the frozen expected-pair count
summaryCampaign.incompleteEvidencePolicy: any frozen pair whose canonical score eligibility is incomplete makes the campaign incomplete; behavior failures with complete evidence remain eligible behavior observations
summaryCampaign.runtimeContainerPolicy: the score collection is checked before iteration; malformed rows fail closed without native TypeError and cannot enter any metric denominator
summaryCampaign.serializedScorePolicy: every reloaded PairScore is bound by ordered trusted slot, checked against its frozen pair/case/contract/repeat/raw-evidence identity, and canonical-JSON compared with the score rederived by the same scorer from persisted repeat inputs; malformed, eligibility, trace, cohort, isolation, case-ID, result, aggregate, or persisted-policy drift is excluded

metrics.jFrozen: count of ordered slots in the verified frozen pair-slot evidence manifest; never inferred from observed rows or score declarations
metrics.jObserved: count of expected frozen pairIds actually supplied
metrics.jEligible: count of pairIds whose two sides and all matched repeats pass integration, trace, identity, isolation, and parity gates
metrics.jIncomplete: jFrozen - jEligible, including entirely missing frozen members

syntheticFixture.canonicalization: strict JSON only; recursive lexicographic object-key order; dense array order preserved; compact finite scalars; own __proto__/constructor/prototype keys preserved
